description: Returns enabled public churches in stable camera ID order, up to 50 per page. next_cursor represents the next page for the same optional literal name/address substring filter; null marks the end. truncated identifies additional matching records. The live catalogue can change during traversal.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page. Bound to the same query.

limit.description: Maximum number of churches to return (default 20, maximum 50).

query.description: Optional literal substring of a church name or address. Preserve Polish diacritics; case folding is limited to ASCII letters. Keep the same query on subsequent pages.

name: list_churches
title: Find public churches
